value.signature: fn from_guard (guard : BootstrapGuard , arguments : Value) -> Result < Self , BootstrapError >

exception.justification: Justified: This entry-origin adapter creates the one explicit command root after installation; a span here would create a second operation.

review.body: { let Some (observation) = guard . 0 . as_ref () else { return Err (ObserverUnavailable :: Writer . into ()) ; } ; let mut root = observation . operation (OperationKind :: Command , arguments) ; root . started = Duration :: ZERO ; Ok (Self { root : Some (root) , _guard : guard , }) }
review.item_premise: This body is the opt-in origin route for observation::OriginInstallation::from_guard; it lends the existing Command operation its entry start and does not change ordinary runner or delivery paths.
